description_en: You can invoke ChangeWorkMode to change the agent's work mode
description_zh: 调用ChangeWorkMode改变坐席的工作模式
kebab_example: aliyun ccc change-work-mode --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id ACC-YUNBS-1.0.10-0000 --work-mode ON_SITE --signed-skill-group-id-list online-1@ccc-test_,_online-2@ccc-test_,_online-3@ccc-test_,_skg-default@ccc-test --mobile 13821140000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeWorkMode

parameters.description_en: Agent ID. If not specified, the agent mapped to the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is used by default.
parameters.description_zh: 坐席ID，不填默认使用当前RAM账号映射的坐席。
parameters.help_en: Agent ID. If not specified, the agent mapped to the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID，不填默认使用当前RAM账号映射的坐席
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description_en: Device ID, which is the identity ID of a browser-based Web Real-Time Communication (WebRTC) softphone or a physical phone device. Only one type of device can be registered at a time.
parameters.description_zh: 设备ID，浏览器WebRTC软电话或实体话机设备的标识ID，同一时间只允许一种设备注册。
parameters.help_en: Device ID, which is the identity ID of a browser-based Web Real-Time Communication (WebRTC) softphone or a physical phone device. Only one type of device can be registered at a time
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，浏览器WebRTC软电话或实体话机设备的标识ID，同一时间只允许一种设备注册
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.description_en: List of skill groups to sign in to. When changing the work mode to off-site mode, you can use this parameter to specify the list of skill groups that the off-site agent needs to sign in to.
parameters.description_zh: 需要签入的技能组列表。当修改工作模式到场外模式时，可以通过此参数指定场外座席需要签入的技能组列表。
parameters.help_en: List of skill groups to sign in to. When changing the work mode to off-site mode, you can use this parameter to specify the list of skill groups that the off-site agent needs to sign in to
parameters.help_zh: 需要签入的技能组列表。当修改工作模式到场外模式时，可以通过此参数指定场外座席需要签入的技能组列表
parameters.name: signed_skill_group_id_list

parameters.description_en: The agent's personal phone number, which is used in off-site mode. The agent can use this number to answer calls in off-site mode.
parameters.description_zh: 坐席的个人电话号码，该号码在场外模式下会用到，坐席可以使用该号码进行场外模式接听。
parameters.help_en: The agent's personal phone number, which is used in off-site mode. The agent can use this number to answer calls in off-site mode
parameters.help_zh: 坐席的个人电话号码，该号码在场外模式下会用到，坐席可以使用该号码进行场外模式接听
parameters.name: mobile
